integrity: The claimed sources introduce the modal axioms and background duality; no priority or authorship over those earlier results is asserted. Direct source equations and all actual numerical verifications were compared before this finding was accepted.
scientific_limitations: The exact labelled enumeration holds for every n>=3; the complete isomorphism-class census is restricted to n=3 and n=4. Computed tests are not an infinite proof; the structural case argument supplies generality. Novelty remains exposed to unindexed equivalent classifications; external audit has not been performed.
title: Exact normal form and census of modal expansions of finite diamond lattices
